page_title: HAV 0-3 REI | Le Havre v Reims 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Teddy Teuma (Reims).

90+3' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Arthur Desmas shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Joseph Okumu (Reims) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Yassine Kechta will be replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
86' It is time for a substitution. Teddy Teuma (Reims) is on for Keito Nakamura.
85' Here is a change. Junya Ito is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
84' The ball possession is 55:45.
82' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' Abdoulaye Toure comes off the pitch to be replaced by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
79' Yehvann Diouf leaps to intercept the corner kick from Christopher Operi (Le Havre).
79' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul after Christopher Operi (Le Havre) hacks down one of his opponents.
77' Reims take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
76' Junya Ito (Reims) works the corner short.
75' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

75' Amine Salama (Reims) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Arthur Desmas. The referee signals a corner kick to Reims.
74' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
73' 10:15 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
71' Here comes a substitution. Amine Salama (Reims) is brought on as a substitute for Oumar Diakite.
71' Substitution. Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) on for Amadou Kone.
70' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Josue Casimir (Le Havre) replaces Yoann Salmier.
69' Here's the change. Emmanuel Sabbi leaves the pitch and Issa Soumare (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
65' Le Havre are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
62' 10:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
58' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Reims players can finally celebrate.
58' Wait! Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
57' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Junya Ito (Reims) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
57' 0 - 3 Goal! Junya Ito (Reims) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:3.
56' Le Havre hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
54' The ball possession at the moment is 58:42.
51' The free kick is delivered by Christopher Operi (Le Havre) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
49' A player from Le Havre commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Corner kicks – 6:1.
42' The resulting set piece from Le Havre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' Luka Elsner is forced to make a change. Buta is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Abdoul Kone (Reims).
39' A goal, which was scored by Keito Nakamura (Reims), was disallowed due to offside.
38' Buta (Reims) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
37' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) will take the free kick.
33' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
33' Le Havre quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
32' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem had an easy-decision to make.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Le Havre.
30' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:1.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergio Akieme (Reims) was quite harsh and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Reims are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
23' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Didier Digard, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
21' 0 - 2 What an excellent finish! Keito Nakamura (Reims) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and lashes the ball into the roof of the net. Unstoppable shot!
20' A cross from a corner kick by Le Havre is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
18' 3:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Oumar Diakite (Reims) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
15' Junya Ito (Reims) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Arthur Desmas.
13' A corner kick by Le Havre is thwarted by the well prepared Yehvann Diouf (Reims).

12' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. The ball is out of play and Le Havre manage to earn a corner.
11' Sergio Akieme (Reims) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
7' Junya Ito (Reims) will take the corner.

6' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Yehvann Diouf has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
5' Le Havre players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
3' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
2' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) for his blatant foul.
2' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
1' The first half has started.
Reims will kick-off.
